title: Gravitation
subtitle: Understanding the Universal Force of Attraction
subject: Science
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Understand the Universal Law of Gravitation.
Calculate the gravitational force between two masses.
Apply concepts to solve numerical problems.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the concepts of gravitation, mass vs weight, and pressure.
common_misconceptions: Mass and weight are the same.
Objects fall faster if they are heavier.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Use analogies like magnets to explain invisible forces, and emphasize that G is universal while g changes.
